Scoped account IDs, cost capture, precise timestamp hydration and account_results to the executive card snapshot. The full dashboard and period-summary retain their existing response and work contracts; frozen historical gate/oracle unchanged.

Removed visible period/provider/timezone metadata, hourly/daily and aggregate badges, chart explanation notes and the chart legend. Reduced chart/loading/empty state height to 320px; date context remains accessible without taking layout space.

The direct/unattributed source row includes only orders the existing Salla attribution classifier does not assign to the four ad platforms. It carries ad_spend_applicable=false; ad spend, CPA and ROAS are not applicable, and net profit subtracts only products, shipping and payment fees.

All-order daily and half-day totals are reduced from the actual filtered Salla orders once. Snapchat orders with unknown or unshown accounts remain in the actual total and coverage.unrepresented_orders; they are never relabeled as direct.

Latest user clarification makes Salla attribution authoritative. No order counts/sales are copied, padded or redistributed to match executive totals; advertising financial scope remains independently verified.

Updated the existing focused UI workflow assertion to verify the retained four-provider table list instead of the explanatory text the user requested removed. No frozen runtime oracle or release guard was modified.

When orders belong to an ad account outside the loaded spend scope, preserve their actual Salla sales/orders/costs but withhold aggregate CPA, ROAS and net profit. Day and half-day scope are checked independently; an affected afternoon does not invalidate an otherwise verified morning.
